entities.summary: Boris Brutskus was a performers & entertainers in Palanga (1874-10-03, Palanga – 1938-12-07) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
